activity_summary: You stood three pews from the Mayor. He gave the litany its answers short and cold, and neither of you looked. The north aisle was full again with the households that went out in July. A dark head under a plain hood did not turn. You learned nothing from the sermon. The jaw had a pulse. The back was the back you brought in.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered the litany, did not look, and lost the sermon.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the filled aisle and the three pews, and carried the cushion home.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Gave the litany, and a sermon that did not stay.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Answered short and cold from his pew, and did not look across.

entities.name: the lady of the parish
entities.context: A dark head under a plain hood in the north aisle. It did not turn, and it did not speak.

facets.activity: Stood three pews from the Mayor

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Every house that went out of the City in July is back in its bench.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have lost the head he is on. I am not going back for it.
